personality_one_liner: A clinical, hyper-clean, and highly readable iOS-native experience that balances medical professionalism with modern AI utility.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Clear grouping of elements. Use md (12) for inner component padding and lg (16) or xl (24) for outer screen margins.

do's: Use for the bottom tab bar.
Use for the sticky top header on the Note Detail screen when scrolling.
Use for the recording bottom sheet handle/header.
dont's: Do not use on regular note cards in the list.
Do not use on form inputs.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce the AI medical assistant value prop and authenticate via Google.
screens.layout: Full-bleed imagery at the top 50% with a gradient-to-dark scrim. Bottom 50% contains the title, description, pagination dots, and a large sticky 'Continue with Google' primary CTA. Safe-area accounted for.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard displaying recent notes, quick filters, and primary action to start a new recording.

states.empty: Illustration of a clean stethoscope and notebook, message 'No consultations logged yet.', CTA 'Start New Note'
states.error: Message 'Unable to load notes' + Retry button

screens.layout: Top nav with personalized greeting and Avatar. Below, a horizontally scrolling row of filter chips (All, Patients, Meetings). Below, a vertical single-column list of note cards (Title, Date, Duration, Tag). A large Floating Action Button (FAB) or fixed bottom CTA for 'New Recording' above the tab bar. Bottom Tab bar: Home, Folders, Search, Profile.

screens.name: New Note (Recording)
screens.purpose: Live audio capture with real-time waveform and duration timer.

states.error: Mic permission denied message + Settings button

screens.layout: Presented as a full-screen glass modal or large bottom sheet. Clean, uncluttered UI. Large centered live waveform, large timer (using mono font). Bottom 1/3 has a prominent pill-shaped 'Stop/Save' CTA. Include a 'Templates' selector button above the mic to pick format (SOAP, Consultation) before saving.

screens.name: Note Detail
screens.purpose: Review processed AI notes across categorized tabs.
screens.layout: Sticky top header with Note Title, Date, and Export/Share icon. Below header, a Segmented Control for Tabs: 'Résumé' (Summary), 'Transcription', 'Actions', 'Plan'. Content area scrolls beneath. Use card-like sections with generous padding. Text should be extremely readable (base 14/16pt, line height 1.5).

screens.name: Folders
screens.purpose: Organize notes by patient or category.

states.empty: Abstract blue tech image + 'No folders created'

screens.layout: Grid layout (2-column). Each folder is a card with a folder icon, Name, and Note count.

screens.name: Templates Picker
screens.purpose: Select the AI structure for the note.
screens.layout: Bottom sheet list of selectable rows: 'SOAP Medical', 'Consultation', 'Meeting', 'Course Notes', 'Expert Analysis'. Each row has a descriptive icon and subtext.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design an epurated, highly professional medical note-taking app blending Doctolib's cleanliness with SmartNoter's AI capabilities.
Use '1 iOS-Native Clean' guidelines. Generous padding, crisp cards, highly legible Plus Jakarta Sans typography.
Ensure color contrast is strictly AA compliant. The primary brand color is a clinical medical blue (#0066CC) per the user's direct request.
The New Note recording screen should heavily emphasize the recording state (large waveform, big timer, uncluttered view) as seen in apps like Otter.ai.
For the Note Detail screen, implement a smooth Tab or Segmented Control to switch between 'Résumé', 'Transcription', 'Actions', and 'Plan'. Content must scroll behind a glass header.
When applying full-bleed images (like on onboarding), ALWAYS apply a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to ensure text readability.
No emojis in the UI. Use Ionicons consistently.
Wire up proper haptics using the provided haptics block for the recording start/stop and tab interactions.
